prompt: Generate a looping raised lava tile with a visibly moving surface. Use a full 128x128 ground base, 32px visible front-wall height, twelve frames at exactly 12 fps, and the same fixed top-down oblique projection. Deliver transparent 192x320px frames with local projected ground anchor (96,248) and a 4-column by 3-row runtime spritesheet. Preserve connected neighboring surfaces, including offset-phase neighbors. Save original generated images, exact prompts, all references, processed sprites, result.json, and review previews in {{OUTPUT_DIR}}.

visualChecks.projection: Screen-aligned square grid; top and front readable; parallel edges, no depth-dependent scale or camera drift.
visualChecks.complete-art: Full silhouette and effects fit the declared frame; no clipped limbs or undeclared shadows.
visualChecks.anchor-placement: Ground/root location matches the guide independently of alpha bounds or visible toe tips.
visualChecks.animated-height: Visible elevation and support stay fixed while the surface moves; no camera/scale breathing.
visualChecks.spatial-seams: Inspect 3x3 animated neighbors through all phases, including offset-phase neighbors; no cracks, gradient jumps, or visible grid seams.
visualChecks.temporal-loop: Motion is readable and the last-to-first transition has no unwanted pop.
visualChecks.frame-consistency: All 12 poses/surfaces are usable, with common identity/palette/light and complete alpha.
visualChecks.source-faithfulness: Compare original generated sources with processed sprites and declared operations; no invented replacement art or unreported geometry fitting.
visualChecks.motion-provenance: Motion and appearance provenance are explicit: distinguish model-drawn phases from authored texture animation. Source art is retained unchanged and processing is reproducible.
